doc.title: Onaje Allan Gumbs interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2001

title: Najee mix-up and closing thanks
summary: A joke about being confused with Najee, then goodbyes.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: That’s happened. It hasn’t happened recently but I went through a whole period, believe me, trust me. It was really for pictures, pictured together with tee shirts—
That says “I’m not Najee,” and his says “I’m not Onaje.” You know.
Well I never had to do that with Thelonious Monk.
Oh yeah a lot of people ask you where you got that from.
They do. Well listen, this has been really fascinating, I’m so glad we ran into each other here, and I bet this is going to be a good year for you.
I’m determined for it to be a good year. You know? So I appreciate your having me.
Thank you. © Hamilton College Jazz Archive -19-
